layers.name: 背景层
layers.prompt: Deep space gradient background from #0a0a1a at top to #1a0a2a at bottom, subtle nebula clouds and star field, dark and immersive atmosphere for a music festival poster

layers.name: 舞台光效
layers.prompt: Multiple colored light beams from center-left and center-right, magenta and cyan, converging toward the center, soft glow with lens flare effect on transparent background

layers.name: 大气粒子
layers.prompt: Floating luminous particles in soft pink and blue, scattered across the scene, some larger bokeh circles, dreamy smoke wisps at bottom, all on transparent background

layers.name: 主体阴影
layers.prompt: Soft elliptical shadow underneath the central subject, dark black with 30% opacity, gently blending into the background, realistic drop shadow on transparent canvas

layers.name: 音乐主体
layers.prompt: Abstract 3D glowing music equalizer waveform made of neon lines and small floating notes, central composition, vibrant cyan and magenta highlights, isolated on transparent background

layers.name: 装饰音符
layers.prompt: Scattered music notes and treble clefs in gold and silver wireframe style, floating around the main equalizer, subtle glow, transparent background

layers.name: 几何装饰
layers.prompt: Thin geometric grid lines and triangles in neon blue, framing the composition from corners, futuristic and minimal, on transparent background

layers.name: 纹理层
layers.prompt: Subtle film grain overlay, fine noise texture, black and white, 10% opacity, adding analog film feel on transparent background

layers.name: 文字效果预览
layers.prompt: Artistic text preview of festival title: '无限音乐' in large bold neon cyan font with glow effect, subtitle '无国界音乐现场' below in smaller gold italic, and body '一场音乐盛典' at bottom in white sans-serif, all on transparent background, positioned as per text layer coordinates
